name: Raxio Tanzania TZ1
notes: Official Raxio page (A, checked 2026-08-12): 'Launching 2026', set to open in Dar es Salaam 2026, country's first carrier-neutral Tier III data centre (operator page claims Uptime Institute Tier III certified; certification record not yet on Uptime list - treat 'certified' wording with caution), 800 racks, 4,000 m2 white space, 6 MW IT power, 33 kV utility supply, 2N power redundancy, located on outskirts of Dar ~30 min from CBD, ~11 connectivity providers. W.Media (B, Jul 2026) repeats 6 MW/800 racks/4,000 m2. Status: under construction, not yet operational (wearetech.africa Mar 2025 confirms Raxio constructing in Dar). Verify TCRA NFL, NEMC EIA, LGA permits, TANESCO 33 kV and Uptime award on next pass.

name: Wingu Africa Tanzania (Dar es Salaam data centre + cable landing station)
notes: Wingu official page (A): launched mid-2022, 'first integrated carrier-neutral data center and cable landing station in the country', carrier-neutral colocation/interconnection/cloud-connect, Dar es Salaam (Mbezi/industrial area per press). Phase-2 expansion announced Mar 2025 (wearetech.africa B) to take facility to ~3 MW (DCD B; Anthony Voscarides LinkedIn); Empower Africa (C/B) says phase 2 completed following ~USD 50m investment. Press (wearetech) says existing facility 'certified Tier 3 by Uptime Institute'; treat certification wording with caution pending Uptime award record. Capacity 3 MW is press-reported phase-2 target.

name: NIDC - National Internet Data Center (TTCL)
developer: Government of Tanzania / TTCL (state telecom operator)
notes: Official NIDC pages (A, methodology-anchored) state the Government of Tanzania constructed the National Internet Data Center in 2015, described as a modern Tier-III data centre in Dar es Salaam operated with/by TTCL, offering cloud/colocation services. btw.media company story (B): NIDC provides secure Tier-III colocation, virtual server hosting, web/email and domain services in Dar es Salaam. Government procurement documents (planning.go.tz) show government paying for NIDC space. Capacity (MW/racks) not published.

name: Aptus Solutions data centre (Dar es Salaam)
notes: Aptus official site (A for services): Dar es Salaam web solutions provider offering web hosting, VPS, dedicated servers, internet access. DataCenterMap (C) lists 'Aptus Solutions Data Center in Dar es Salaam' - first Tanzanian VPS/dedicated provider with servers in central Dar, UPS/generator backup. ISP hosting facility; capacity not published. Grade C for facility status (directory corroboration only).

name: Vodacom Tanzania data centre (Laibon Rd / Old Bagamoyo Rd leads)
notes: DataCenterMap (C) lists a Vodacom Dar es Salaam Data Center near Laibon Road; Vodacom HQ is on Old Bagamoyo Road, Ursino Estate. A 'Solutions Architect - Data Center Solutions' job posting confirms Vodacom Tanzania runs data-centre/cloud solution functions. Per TZ methodology treat as telco-owned data-centre/hosting lead until official page/TCRA/council evidence confirms a commercial colo facility; directories are C for address/capacity.

name: Airtel Tanzania data centre (Bagamoyo Rd)
notes: DataCenterMap (C) lists Airtel Tanzania Data Center at Bagamoyo Rd, Dar es Salaam. Airtel/Telesonic also activated the 2Africa cable segment linking Kenya-Tanzania-South Africa (2024, B - Submarine Networks), which is network/cable evidence not a commercial DC. Per methodology count only if a physical compute/colo facility is corroborated by A/B source; currently C-grade directory lead.

name: Stellarix data centre (Tier III claim, unverified)
notes: Single LinkedIn/pulse article (C) claims Stellarix operates Tanzania's first Tier III-certified data centre and plans a national network of facilities across Dar es Salaam, Dodoma, Mwanza and Arusha. No company website, TCRA record or press corroboration found in this pass (searches returned nothing for Stellarix). Keep as C-grade lead only; do not count as a confirmed facility until corroborated.

name: Dodoma public data centre (government/eGA)
notes: Ecofin Agency (B, 2025-11-21): 'The government supervises the construction of two public data centers. The first, located in Dodoma, is already in the equipment phase.' eGA Data Center Standards and Guidelines for Public Institutions (2026-02-18, A) and eGA Strategic Plan (A) confirm government shared data-centre infrastructure management. Facility-level site/capacity not published; status: under construction (equipment phase as of Nov 2025).

name: Zanzibar public data centre (eGA-managed)
developer: e-Government Authority (eGA) / Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar (SMZ)
notes: Ecofin Agency (B, 2025-11-21): second of two public data centres being constructed, located in Zanzibar and managed by eGA (Mjini Magharibi / Zanzibar Urban-West). Facility-level site (Zanzibar City/Fumba area lead per methodology), capacity and stage beyond 'under construction' unconfirmed. A National Cybersecurity Centre announced 2024 will complement these facilities. Keep status construction until Zanzibar government/ZIPA/eGA procurement evidence confirms operation.

name: Oman Data Park Zanzibar data centre (MoU)
developer: Oman Data Park / Zanzibar Ministry of Infrastructure, Communications and Transport
notes: MoU signed Oct 2022 between Oman Data Park and Zanzibar's Ministry of Infrastructure, Communications and Transport to establish, manage and operate a data centre in Zanzibar (Times of Oman / Muscat Daily, B). No public construction, procurement or operation evidence found since (2026-08-12 sweep); keep as planned/lead per TZ methodology - do not count as a built facility. Related: eGA-managed Zanzibar public data centre is separately tracked as under construction.

name: Stellarix planned Arusha data centre (unverified)

Per TZ methodology Arusha is a low-probability commercial-colo region (telco cores, bank/enterprise DR, EAC/NGO institutional IT). Recorded as C-grade planned lead only; not a confirmed facility.
